title: ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32147v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. translated_title: ARS-VLM：面向视觉-语言模型的视觉对齐增强随机搜索
translated_abstract: 以群体相对策略优化（GRPO）为代表的一阶强化学习被广泛用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的多模态推理后训练。然而，这类方法因反向传播、优化器状态和参考模型而带来沉重的内存与系统开销。仅前向传播的零阶（ZO）方法，如进化策略（ES）及其top-k变体增强随机搜索（ARS），通过奖励引导的权重扰动规避了这些开销，但在VLM推理领域尚未被探索。我们发现，直接将标准ES或原始ARS应用于VLM会出现两种根本性的失败模式：(i) 图像块网格过拟合，即模型拟合脆弱的网格特定视觉token伪影而忽略空间不变性；(ii) 灾难性遗忘，即由于无界的高秩参数与策略漂移导致通用感知能力和分布外（OOD）任务性能下降。我们提出了ARS-VLM，一种视觉对齐的增强随机搜索方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出ARS-VLM，一种视觉对齐的增强随机搜索零阶方法，解决了直接将进化策略类算法应用于视觉-语言模型时的图像块网格过拟合和灾难性遗忘两大失败模式，同时规避了GRPO等一阶强化学习带来的内存与系统开销。
en_tdlr: We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search (zeroth-order) method that overcomes the two fundamental failure modes—patch-grid overfitting and catastrophic forgetting—when applying ES/ARS to VLMs, while avoiding the heavy memory and system overhead of first-order RL methods like GRPO.
